list: The official 55 trophies as PlayStation publishes them, with a guide in the maker's own words for each one.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn, and you cannot chase it directly. It pops the moment the other 54 are done, so treat it as a progress marker: work the roadmap in order, clear the missable story trophies on your first pass, and let the collectibles and activities fill in behind them.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.
Use the tracker at the top of this guide to see exactly what is left.

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Play through the opening beats, learn the movement, driving and combat basics the mission teaches, and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and follow the opening prompts.
Complete each Gone Fishing objective as it appears.
The trophy unlocks on the mission complete screen.

trophies.guide: Chapter 1 closes the opening stretch of the story. Play its missions in order, and do not rush past the side activities the chapter introduces: the trophy pops at the chapter complete screen, and anything you skip here can be picked up later in free roam.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play every Chapter 1 story mission in order.
Finish the chapter's closing mission.
The trophy pops when Chapter 1 completes.

trophies.guide: Chapter 2 is where the story opens up across Leonida. Work through its missions in order; the chapter complete screen is what triggers this trophy, so there is nothing extra to hunt down for it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play every Chapter 2 story mission in order.
Finish the chapter's closing mission.
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 completes.

trophies.guide: Chapter 3 brings the story into Vice City proper. Keep playing the missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter complete screen. If you are hunting missables, make sure the partner trophies tied to this stretch are done before you move on.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play every Chapter 3 story mission in order.
Finish the chapter's closing mission.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 completes.

trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the late-story stretch before the finale. Play its missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter complete screen, leaving only the final mission between you and the gold story trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play every Chapter 4 story mission in order.
Finish the chapter's closing mission.
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 completes.

trophies.guide: This gold trophy marks the end of the story. Finish the final mission and it pops on the credits roll. It is unmissable, so there is no wrong way to reach it, but finish the missable story trophies first: after the finale, some story moments cannot be replayed.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete Chapters 1 to 4 first.
Play the final mission to its end.
The trophy pops when the story concludes.

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission, and this trophy is tied to that one moment in the story. Play it when it appears on your map and finish it in the same sitting if you can; a trophy tied to a single mission is safest done on the first pass rather than left for a replay.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Watch for the Breakfast Run mission marker during the early story.
Start it as soon as it appears and play it through.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is one of the story's big set-piece missions. It only happens once in the story, so take it when it appears and finish it; heist missions usually have a setup phase first, so follow the setup objectives before the heist itself.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Complete the heist setup objectives when they appear.
Play The Cartel Heist mission through to the end.
The trophy pops when the heist completes.

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission with a single window in the plot. Start it when its marker appears and see it through to the end; do not leave story missions half-finished while you wander off to free roam, or you may have to replay the chapter to get the moment back.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Watch for the Child's Play mission marker in the story.
Start it as soon as it appears and play it through.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission, and this trophy belongs to that one mission alone. Play it when it unlocks and finish it in full; mission-tied trophies are the easiest ones to miss by postponing them, so do this one on the first pass.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Watch for the Headliners mission marker in the story.
Start it as soon as it appears and play it through.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is set at the airport and tied to a single story mission. Take it when it appears, follow the takedown objectives, and finish the mission; like the other named story missions, it is safest earned on the first pass.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Watch for the VCIA Takedown mission marker in the story.
Start it as soon as it appears and play it through.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission, so this trophy comes from that mission alone. Start it when its marker appears and play it to the end; once the story moves past it, the moment is gone until a replay.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Watch for the Operation Savage Glory mission marker in the story.
Start it as soon as it appears and play it through.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: The 100% completion gold sits at the end of everything: story, strangers, activities, collectibles and exploration. Use this guide's tracker and the in-game stats screen to find what is left, and clear the collectible stages last so the final percentage ticks over in one clean sweep.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story and every stranger mission strand.
Clear all activities, collectibles and exploration goals.
The trophy pops the moment the in-game completion counter hits 100%.

trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime, and the counter runs all game long, so this silver builds itself if you drive boldly. To finish it deliberately, chain stunt jumps and long drifts on open highways and around the airport runways, where you can repeat attempts without traffic getting in the way.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive fast and take stunt jumps whenever you see one.
Chain drifts, near misses and airtime to raise the count faster.
The trophy pops at 250 completed stunts.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types across Leonida, and this trophy only asks you to try each one once: no wins, no high scores, just a single attempt at each. Work down the list in one free-roam session, ticking each type off in the tracker as you try it.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Try each type once, in any order, in a single session.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges, and this silver wants a gold medal in every one of them. Learn each range's target pattern first with a practice run, then go for gold: steady aim beats fast firing, and the challenges can be retried as often as you like, so a missed gold costs nothing but time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a Shooting Range and open the challenge list.
Practice each challenge once to learn its pattern.
Replay each until you hold a gold medal in all 42.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 locations around Leonida. You need a win at each one, so treat it as a tour: fly each course once to learn its gates, then race it properly. Short, tight courses reward smooth lines more than raw speed.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location on the map.
Fly the course once to learn the gate layout.
Win a race at all 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Twenty different races need a win each, so variety matters more than repeating one easy race. Work through the race list across Leonida, pick a fast, stable car for each, and tick each win off in the tracker so you never re-race one you have already won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Open the race list and pick an unwon race.
Win it with a fast, stable car.
Repeat until 20 different races are won.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is your fishing rival, and this trophy comes from beating him head to head in a fishing challenge. Learn the reeling rhythm first: steady pressure when the fish runs, reel in when it tires. One clean win over Cal is all it takes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find a fishing spot and open a fishing challenge against Cal.
Keep steady pressure and reel when the fish tires.
Beat Cal once and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Arcades across Leonida hold full games of their own, and this trophy only asks you to finish one. Pick the shortest game on the machine, learn its controls in the first minute, and play it through to its end screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade and step up to a machine.
Pick a game and learn its controls.
Play it through to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy hands out a strand of side missions, and this trophy is for his last one. Follow his strand to its end and finish the final mission when it appears; side-mission strands can dry up if the story moves on, so do not leave Andy's missions hanging for too long.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Meet Andy and work through his mission strand.
Watch for his final mission marker.
Complete it to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends with a final mission of its own. Play through his missions in order and take the last one when it appears; like the other contact strands, it is safest finished before the story's final stretch.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Meet Kenton and work through his mission strand.
Watch for his final mission marker.
Complete it to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand builds to a last mission, and this trophy pops when you finish it. Keep his missions moving alongside the story rather than saving them all for the end, so the strand is still open when you need it.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Meet Billy and work through his mission strand.
Watch for his final mission marker.
Complete it to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers across Leonida each offer a short mission strand, and this silver wants 8 of them finished. Stranger markers appear on the map as you explore, so roam widely and take each strand as you find it; eight completed strands is the goal, and there are more strangers than you need.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for stranger markers on the map.
Start each stranger's mission strand when you find one.
Complete 8 full strands to earn the silver.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand ends with a final mission, and this trophy pops when you finish it. Work his missions in order and take the last one promptly when it appears, before the story moves past the point where his strand is available.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Meet Randy and work through his mission strand.
Watch for his final mission marker.
Complete it to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand builds to a last mission of its own. Play his missions in order and finish the final one when it shows up; contact strands are best cleared while the story is still in their part of the map.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Meet Tyrone and work through his mission strand.
Watch for his final mission marker.
Complete it to earn the trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots scattered across Leonida, from beaches to hilltops. Each one is a quiet place to stop and meditate; visit all 18 and the trophy pops. Mark each spot in the tracker as you find it so you never revisit one you have already done.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Explore Leonida and watch for meditation spot markers.
Meditate at each spot you find.
The trophy pops at all 18 spots.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants one specific unique animal hunted down. Follow his clues to the animal's territory, track it quietly, and take the shot cleanly; unique animals do not respawn on demand, so do not scare it off before you are in range.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's hunt and follow his clues to the territory.
Track the unique animal without spooking it.
Take it down cleanly to earn the trophy.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden across Leonida in sets, and this silver wants 3 full sets completed. Cards hide in shops, houses and odd corners, so search thoroughly and trade notes with the tracker: a finished set is one you never have to think about again.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Search Leonida for collectible cards in every district.
Collect full sets, card by card.
The trophy pops when your third set is complete.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the game's photo-sharing spot check, and this silver wants it done at 100 different locations. Any scenic or notable spot counts, so fold it into your exploration: snap a WAiNK shot everywhere you go and the count climbs without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK camera at a new location.
Take the shot to log that location.
Repeat at 100 different locations.

trophies.guide: Challenges are the small goals layered over everything you do, from driving feats to combat trick shots. Fifty of them is a natural total for an active player: keep an eye on the challenge list, chase the easy ones first, and the trophy pops midway through a normal playthrough.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenges list and note the easy ones.
Chase the quickest challenges first.
The trophy pops at 50 completed challenges.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: This one needs your partner beside you and a 4-star wanted level to lose. Build the heat together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars fade; a fast car and a quiet corner of the map do the job better than a shootout.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Play with your partner beside you and build a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and hide until the stars fade.
Escape clean and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three shop robberies in a row, with your partner, without ever losing your wanted level. Plan a route with three close shops, keep the getaway car ready, and move fast between them: the wanted level must stay live the whole time, so do not let the heat drop between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together and park a fast getaway car nearby.
Rob them back to back with your partner, keeping your wanted level.
The trophy pops after the third robbery.

trophies.guide: One hundred different vehicles need discovering, from beat-up sedans to rare exotics. Every new model you sit in counts, so drive everything you see: steal a car, drive it a short way, and move on to the next. Rare spawns hide in wealthy districts and at car meets.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Get in every new vehicle model you see and drive it briefly.
Check wealthy districts and car meets for rare spawns.
The trophy pops at 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and steadies your aim, and this trophy wants five takedowns inside one use of it. Trigger it in a crowded fight, pick your targets in order, and make every shot count; the window is short, so enter the fight with a full weapon and a clear line on five enemies.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with at least five enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus with a full weapon.
Down five enemies before the focus ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is the airport, and this trophy is about leaving it in a way the schedule never planned. Get airside, grab a plane, and take off without waiting for permission; the runway is long and the skies are open, so once you are airborne the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Get to VCIA airport and find a plane airside.
Take off without following the scheduled departure.
The trophy pops once you are airborne.

trophies.guide: Rhino tanks turn up when the heat is at its highest, and this trophy is about surviving an encounter with one. Let a tank roll in, keep moving so its cannon cannot track you, and get clear of it; sticky bombs and distance are your friends, and the trophy pops once you walk away from a Rhino encounter in one piece.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Raise the heat until a Rhino tank rolls in.
Keep moving so its cannon cannot track you.
Get clear of the tank and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A clean jewelry job means in and out with nobody ever knowing you were there. Case the store first, learn the guard patrols and camera angles, then move quietly: no alarms, no witnesses, no rush. One silent run is all it takes.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Case the jewelry store and learn the patrols.
Enter quietly and avoid every camera and guard.
Leave undetected and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, each robbed and escaped from cleanly. Vault jobs are the heavy end of robbery: plan the entry, crack the vault, and have the getaway ready before the alarm starts, because the escape is where most runs fail. Five clean escapes earn the silver.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Plan a bank vault job and stage a getaway car.
Crack the vault and grab the take.
Escape clean, five times, to earn the silver.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run set routes through the city, and this trophy wants one robbed and escaped from. Stop the truck, get inside, grab the cash, and be gone before the response arrives; a fast car parked nearby turns a good robbery into a clean one.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and stop it.
Get inside and take the cash.
Escape before the response arrives.

trophies.guide: Leonida has 52 areas to discover, from Vice City's neon streets to the swamps and small towns. Drive every road, visit every district, and the map fills in area by area; the tracker in this guide pairs with the in-game map so you can see which areas are still blank.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive through every district of Leonida.
Watch the map fill in as each new area registers.
The trophy pops at all 52 areas.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs running illegal operations across Leonida, and this trophy wants one operation robbed from each of them. Learn each gang's territory, hit one operation per gang, and get out clean; nine gangs, nine robberies, one trophy.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Learn the 9 gangs and where each operates.
Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang.
The trophy pops when the ninth gang is hit.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Ocean Beach is the postcard end of Vice City, and this trophy is a quiet moment there: order a cocktail with the ocean in front of you. It is tied to a specific place and a specific mood, so do it while you are passing through the beachfront rather than saving it for the endgame.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Head to Ocean Beach on the Vice City beachfront.
Find a bar with a view of the ocean.
Order a cocktail and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Some showrooms are made to be driven out of, glass and all. Pick a showroom, pick a fast car inside it, and leave through the front window in the grand old style; the trophy is about the exit, so make it loud.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and get inside a fast car.
Aim for the front glass and floor it.
Smash out in style and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is a real place with real lanes, and this trophy is about following through on a game there. Bowl a full game, follow through on your throws, and the trophy pops when the game ends.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game and follow through on each throw.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.guide: This trophy is about the partnership at the heart of the story reaching the public eye. Keep playing the story with your partner and the moment comes on its own: it is a story beat, not a grind, so just keep the plot moving.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play the story with your partner.
Reach the partnership moment the game builds toward.
The trophy pops when the moment lands.

trophies.guide: Leonida keeps score of the choices you make, and PlayStation tracks this one to 500 choices. Every dialogue pick, every story decision and every free-roam choice counts, so this trophy builds itself across a full playthrough: just keep choosing, and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices in dialogue and story missions as you play.
Keep choosing across free roam too.
The trophy pops at 500 choices.

trophies.guide: Some things only work on the second try, and this trophy is for exactly that: fail at something once, then succeed at it on the next attempt. It comes naturally during a normal playthrough, so do not force it; the next time something goes wrong, try it once more.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail an attempt at any challenge or activity.
Try it again right away.
Succeed on the second try and the trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Leonida hides strange sights for players who wander off the beaten path: odd encounters, unexplained events, things that make you stop the car and stare. Roam the odd corners of the map, especially at night, and this trophy pops when you witness something genuinely strange.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Roam the odd corners of Leonida, especially at night.
Keep an eye out for strange encounters.
Witness one and the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by is exactly what it sounds like: swinging a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowling someone over. Line up a slow pass past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops when the hit connects.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Equip a melee weapon and get in a car.
Drive slowly past a pedestrian.
Swing as you pass and bowl them over.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from the bigger scores, and laundering them through your contacts turns dirty money clean at a cut. Keep laundering after every major job and the total climbs: $250,000 laundered is the goal, and every job you finish feeds it.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills from scores and jobs.
Launder them through your contacts.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

trophies.guide: A hundred thousand dollars across all the shops of Leonida: clothes, cars, weapons, food, all of it counts. Spend naturally as you gear up through the story and this one takes care of itself; if you are close, a car purchase closes the gap in one go.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear, clothes, cars and weapons as you play.
Watch the total climb across every shop.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.guide: There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida, and this trophy wants the full set. Garages are also where your vehicle collection lives, so buy them as you find them rather than saving them all for the end; each purchase is a step toward the trophy and a home for your cars.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Find garage properties for sale across Leonida.
Buy each one as you find it.
The trophy pops when all 8 are yours.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles you find, and this trophy wants 10 of them on the books. Drive a vehicle you like, open the app, register it, and repeat; ten registrations across your travels is all it takes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Drive a vehicle you want to keep.
Open the Scooter Bros app and register it.
Register 10 vehicles to earn the trophy.
